chapters.label: Two saves, live
chapters.text: Qatar 2022: Morocco against Spain, penalties! Carlos Soler shoots low. Yassine Bounou, called Bono, blocks it! Next, Sergio Busquets steps up. Bono dives right... Saved again! The fans go wild!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch Busquets' kick again, slowly. Bono stays calm and reads him. Small steps... then a strong push, and his right hand saves it!

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: Now Soler's kick, from behind the goal. Low and central: Bono drops and smothers it!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Keepers, stay calm and read the kicker. Take small steps to stay balanced, then push off strong and reach!
